signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential frontage with the house partly obscured by a large tree in the foreground.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed rounded shrubs along the foundation and a mulched tree base, but nothing indicating a crew or a service.

signals.notes: Colonial-style home with an attached two-car garage and a clean asphalt driveway, mature trees, and a red front door; the house is partly screened by a large tree, so some of the roof and facade are hard to see.
